name: Gloam
author: E. T. Carter
description: A deep twilight color field — cool indigo and slate poles drift through near-black while one luminous pole blooms off-centre like the last light low in the sky. The dark anchor of the family: grainy, moody, glowing.

params.label: Drift speed
params.effect: How fast the twilight poles drift; 0 holds the dusk almost still.

params.label: Blob size
params.effect: Influence radius of the poles; low keeps tight colour pools, high spreads broad banks.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Brightness of the luminous pole blooming through the dark; 0 leaves an even twilight.

params.label: Drift warp
params.effect: Organic distortion of the colour edges; low is smooth, high adds folds.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer pulls the field toward it; 0 ignores the mouse.
